name: ConBotics MalerRoboter 2.0
summary: Battery-powered painting robot from Berlin that sprays walls with any airless unit up to 3.2 m high while a painter prepares, masks and refills.

germany.statusNote: Made in Berlin; rented and ordered through the maker's contact form ("Order now", "Rent a Robot"). The FAQ still says sales start was planned for 2025 and rental is the main route; price on request.

sellers.name: ConBotics GmbH
sellers.note: Bismarckstrasse 10-12, 10625 Berlin. Rental and purchase on request; TechnoMaler service pairs the robot with painting firms.

specs.label: Total weight
specs.conditions: without airless unit; the same page also says 130 kg

specs.label: Battery runtime
specs.conditions: spec block; the FAQ says up to 8 h with a swappable battery

notes: Uses the customer's airless sprayer; walls only, ceilings and sloped ceilings still in development per FAQ.
Operator draws a rough floor plan in the app; masking and detail work stay manual.
Dismantles into four parts for carrying between floors.
